lead: `Core\ObjectSet`'s `union`, `intersect` and `diff` answer a set no declaration accepts, so a derived set is only *chained*.
body: Their `return_ty` is `CoreTy::Instance(NAME)`, no type argument, so `Core\ObjectSet<Tag> $u = $a->union($b);` is `E0401` and bare `Core\ObjectSet $u` is `E0442`. Write every law as one chain (`$a->diff($b)->union($a->intersect($b))->diff($a)->count() == 0`); `Core\ObjectMap` is the same.
